name: Customer
definition: A registered buyer of Lumo Outdoors; one row per customer in customers.
scope: All order, tier and region analysis

name: Order
definition: A purchase transaction placed by a customer; one row per order in orders, with one or more order items.
scope: All order counting; includes pending and cancelled orders

name: Valid Order
definition: An order whose status is paid, shipped or delivered (status 1, 2, 3). Pending-payment (0) and cancelled (9) orders are not valid orders.
scope: Basis for order counts, revenue, average order value, repeat customers and channel share

name: Order Status
definition: Lifecycle state of an order, stored as integer code (0 pending payment, 1 paid, 2 shipped, 3 delivered, 9 cancelled).

name: Order Time
definition: Time an order was placed; stored in UTC and reported in Taipei time (UTC+8) for day, month, quarter and year.
scope: Period attribution of orders, order counts, revenue and average order value

name: Sales Channel
definition: Channel through which an order was placed: web (官網), app (行動 App) or store (實體門市).

name: Mobile App Channel
definition: Orders placed through the mobile app (channel value app).

name: Customer Tier
definition: Membership level of a customer: B (一般會員), S (銀級會員), G (黃金會員); current value per customer.

name: Gold Member
definition: Customers whose tier is G (黃金會員).

name: Customer Region
definition: Region or country code of a customer: TW-N 北部, TW-C 中部, TW-S 南部, JP 日本, SG 新加坡; current value per customer.

name: Northern Taiwan Region
definition: Customers whose region_code is TW-N (北部).

name: Product
definition: A sellable item in the catalog; one row per product in products.

name: Active (On-sale) Product
definition: Products currently on sale (is_active = 1); is_active = 0 means delisted. A current-state flag, not time-versioned.
scope: Questions about products currently on sale

name: Product Category
definition: Merchandise category of a product: backpack 登山背包, tent 帳篷, shoes 登山鞋, apparel 機能服飾, accessory 配件.

name: Order Item
definition: A product line within an order (quantity at a transaction unit price); one row per order_items record.

name: Payment Record
definition: An attempt to pay an order; one row per payments record. An order can have several records (failed attempts plus at most one successful).

name: Payment Method
definition: How a payment was made: credit_card 信用卡, line_pay LINE Pay, atm ATM 轉帳, cod 貨到付款.

name: Refund
definition: A refund granted against one item of an order; one row per refunds record, referencing the item and its order.

name: Refund Time
definition: Time a refund occurred; stored in UTC and reported in Taipei time (UTC+8).
scope: Period attribution of the refund report

name: Item Amount
definition: Merchandise value of an order item: quantity times the transaction unit price (actual price paid, discount already included, not the catalog list price), expressed in TWD.
scope: Basis of revenue and average order value

name: Refund Amount Attributed to Original Order
definition: Refund amount deducted from the original order's revenue, assigned to the period of the order's creation time regardless of when the refund occurred.

name: Net Revenue
definition: Sum of item amounts of valid orders in the period (by order time) minus refund amounts of those orders.
scope: Revenue reporting by period, tier, region, channel

name: Average Order Value
definition: Sum of item amounts of valid orders in the period (refunds not deducted) divided by the number of valid orders in the period.

name: Repeat Customer
definition: A customer with at least 2 valid orders within one (Taipei) calendar year.

name: App Order Share
definition: Share of valid orders in a period that were placed through the mobile app, as a percentage of valid order count.

name: Received Amount
definition: Total amount of successful payment records (payment_status ok); failed attempts are excluded.
scope: Money actually received, by payment method

name: Refund Amount (Refund Report)
definition: Total refund amount attributed to the period in which the refund occurred (refund time), as used by the refund report.
scope: Refund reporting by period or product category

name: Sales Quantity
definition: Number of units sold of a product, summed over order item quantities.
